metadata.file_name: 210. Kuang (2026). Evaluating Neural Networks Architectures for Competency Prediction from Process Data Using PISA Computer-Based Mathematics Assessment.pdf
metadata.title: Evaluating Neural Networks Architectures for Competency Prediction from Process Data Using PISA Computer-Based Mathematics Assessment

design_fields.q1_rationale: Process data study predicting item correctness, not PV-based achievement.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Prior extraction indicates weights not used.
design_fields.q3_rationale: Student-level neural networks without school clustering.
design_fields.q1_rationale: Publisher full text, §2.4: model comparison uses PV1 only (one plausible value).
design_fields.q2_rationale: Publisher full text, §§2.1–2.8: student sampling weights are not reported for model fitting.
design_fields.q3_rationale: Publisher full text, §§2.1–2.8: student-level RNN models and student-level CV; no school-level clustering method reported.
design_fields.q4_rationale: Publisher full text, §2.8.1: five-fold student-level cross-validation within the U.S. sample; no external country, cycle, or dataset validation.
design_fields.q4b_note: Publisher full text, §2.1: U.S. PISA 2012 sample only.
